evaluation.summary: A2 transfers production canonical local-archive ownership to the Rust archiver. RustArchiver acquires a complete GEL snapshot before transactional materialization, may atomically create a fresh schema-v2 database, and delegates all SQLite mutation to the crate-private ArchiveSyncRepository. Python v4.9 is retained only as historical/reference parity authority.

public_read_surface.open_mode: existing schema-v2 SQLite database; SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY plus PRAGMA query_only=ON

student_exists.description: Check if a student UID exists in the archive
student_exists.sql_pattern: SELECT 1 FROM students WHERE uid = ?1 LIMIT 1
student_exists.privacy: No student data returned, only existence boolean

public_read_surface.revision_rule: Revision source is returned only when the canonical tutorial identity is source-present, its governed source state is source-present, and authority is proven_per_tutorial or shared_identical_collision. Unknown/missing/blocked authority and stale presence fail closed.

archive_sync_write_surface.open_mode: existing schema-v2 SQLite database; read-write without CREATE
archive_sync_write_surface.production_entry_point: gel-core/src/archiver.rs#RustArchiver; database creation is owned by RustArchiver, not ArchiveSyncRepository

transaction_semantics.run_record: archive_sync_runs running row is inserted before the materialization transaction so a failed run remains observable
transaction_semantics.materialization: All candidate archive writes for one repository sync operation occur in one SQLite transaction.
transaction_semantics.success: Within the transaction mark the run complete, perform permitted invalidation, validate repository semantic/FK invariants, then commit.
transaction_semantics.failure: Rollback every materialization write, preserve prior archive rows/presence, and mark the outer sync run failed.
transaction_semantics.commit_failure: Attempt to mark the outer run failed and return a hard error.
transaction_semantics.network_rule: RustArchiver completes GEL HTTP acquisition before ArchiveSyncRepository::run_sync opens the materialization transaction; transaction closures never own network acquisition.

scope_invalidation.full: A successful fully-evidenced full sync may mark unseen classes, students, memberships, tutorial identities, source states and collision groups source_present=0 using presence_checked_run_id for that completed run. Rows are preserved, never deleted.
scope_invalidation.targeted: Targeted syncs never infer absence and never mark unseen source rows not present.
scope_invalidation.failed: Failed/rolled-back syncs never invalidate prior source presence.
scope_invalidation.partial_auxiliary: If mandatory class/roster/tutorial-list acquisition succeeds but summary/print/edit evidence is partial, A2 uses full:preserve_source_evidence: unseen identities are still invalidated, but prior unseen source states/collision groups are retained for student+timestamp keys that this run still observed in the API. Evidence for actually disappeared tutorial keys is invalidated.

canonical_identity.locator: student_uid+tutorial_ts remains a reconciliation key, not identity

source_state_fingerprint.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), strings trimmed, booleans normalized to 0/1

association_rules.proven_per_tutorial: requires same-key source_state_id and no collision_group_id
association_rules.shared_identical_collision: requires identical_state collision group membership for the tutorial ID and source state
association_rules.ambiguous_divergent_collision: requires divergent_state collision membership and source_state_id=NULL
association_rules.incomplete_collision_evidence: requires incomplete_evidence collision membership and source_state_id=NULL
association_rules.ambiguous_collision_unknown: requires ambiguous_unknown collision membership and source_state_id=NULL

repository_commit_invariants: Every source-present class membership has source-present class and student parents.
Every source-present tutorial identity/source state/collision group has a source-present student parent.
Every source-present tutorial identity has a governed tutorial_state_associations row.
Shared-identical associations reference group-owned identities and source states in an identical_state group.
Divergent/incomplete/unknown blocked associations reference group-owned identities of the matching collision kind and carry no source_state_id.
A source-present identical_state collision has at least two API identities and exactly one deduplicated semantic source state.
A source-present divergent_state collision has at least two API identities and at least two distinct source states.
PRAGMA foreign_key_check is clean before commit.
